about: Every datapoint of both sets judged by hand on 2026-09-05, not a sample: the question read as a user would read it, the figure recomputed in Python from the raw transactions, and only then the reference statement run through the guard and compared. correct, fixed (what was wrong is in the note) or dropped. The ids that begin with draft: are generated candidates the judging refused, so they are in no set; every other id is in one.
